textCaption: Hi there, explorers! I’m Dr. Andrew Farke, paleontologist. Nice to meet you!

You see that cute little dinosaur over there?  @look 
That’s<color=orange> “Baby Joe.” </color>
Baby Joe is a Parasaurolophus that lived during the Cretaceous period, in a place we call Utah today. @lookend
Today, we’re going on an amazing adventure to learn about <color=orange>ontogeny.</color>
... That might sound intimidating, but that just means we’re going to learn how animals grow up.
